name: Garden Governed ReviewPacket Next One Use

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/review-packet-next-20260915-0915
    paths:
      - tools/evidence/build_next_governed_review_packet.py
      - .github/workflows/governed-review-packet-next-one-use.yml

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  build-governed-review-packet:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Build under merged GardenProcess engine
        id: packet
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m compileall -q implementation/garden_kernel tools/evidence/build_next_governed_review_packet.py
          python tools/evidence/build_next_governed_review_packet.py

      - name: Persist immutable cycle evidence
        env:
          CYCLE_ID: ${{ steps.packet.outputs.cycle_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$CYCLE_ID"
          git config user.name "garden-evidence-bot"
          git config user.email "garden-evidence-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "evidence/review-packets/$CYCLE_ID"
          git diff --cached --quiet && { echo "No evidence generated" >&2; exit 1; }
          git commit -m "Persist governed GardenReviewPacket $CYCLE_ID [engine-bound evidence-only]"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Governed Garden ReviewPacket"
            echo "- CycleID: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.cycle_id }}`"
            echo "- route: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.route }}`"
            echo "- SectionUnit: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.selected_section_unit }}`"
            echo "- packet_hash: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.packet_hash }}`"
            echo "- completeness: **${{ steps.packet.outputs.completeness_status }}**"
            echo "- process state: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.process_state }}`"
            echo "- blockers: `${{ steps.packet.outputs.blocker_count }}`"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
